# drozq.com

> Joshua Guerrero, licensed California real estate agent (DRE #02267255) with Real Brokerage, based in Irvine and serving Orange County home sellers and buyers. Direct line (949) 438-5948. This site publishes live market data, transparent cost math, and real closed-deal numbers.

## Sell-side resources

- [Cost to sell a house in Orange County](https://drozq.com/cost-to-sell/): every 2026 line item (commission, escrow, title, $1.10/$1,000 county transfer tax), a worked $1,200,000 example netting $726,930, capital gains exclusion, and Prop 19 tax-base transfer.
- [Selling an inherited house in Orange County](https://drozq.com/inherited-house/): probate vs trust timelines (30-60 days from a trust, 4-9 months in probate), the step-up in basis, Prop 19 reassessment after 2021, sibling buyouts, and the five-step estate sale process.
- [Selling a house during divorce in California](https://drozq.com/divorce-sale/): community property and the 50/50 baseline, automatic restraining orders after service, the three exits (sell and split, buyout, deferred sale order), the $500,000 married capital gains clock, and a neutral sale process.
- [Sell now or wait: the 2026 framework](https://drozq.com/sell-now-or-wait/): the three checkable numbers (rate spread vs today's live 30-year, months of inventory, distance to the never-indexed $250k/$500k gains cap), the cost of waiting a year on $1,200,000, and when each choice honestly wins.
- [Sell your house as-is in Orange County](https://drozq.com/sell-as-is/): what as-is means in California (the Transfer Disclosure Statement survives it), the fix-or-credit-or-price framework, which repairs return 2-3x and which never do, the three buyer pools, and CA's point-of-sale requirements (smoke/CO alarms, water heater strapping).
- [Selling a tenant-occupied rental in California](https://drozq.com/sell-with-tenants/): the lease survives the sale, in-place vs vacant buyer pools, AB 1482 just-cause rules and the single-family exemption, 60-day notices, cash for keys (one to three months' rent), depreciation recapture at 25%, and the 45/180-day 1031 exchange clock.
- [Pre-foreclosure in California](https://drozq.com/pre-foreclosure/): the real nonjudicial timeline (roughly 230+ days: 120-day federal wait, 90-day Notice of Default, 20-day sale notice), reinstatement up to 5 business days before the sale, Homeowner Bill of Rights protections, why the NOD floods your mailbox with investor letters (and the 5-day cancel right), and every exit ranked by what you keep.
- [Short sales in California](https://drozq.com/short-sale/): the are-you-actually-underwater check, CCP 580e's no-deficiency release (junior liens included), why the forgiven balance is generally not taxable in California (nonrecourse treatment), the 60-120 day approval run at zero seller cost, and buy-again timelines of 2 to 4 years vs up to 7 after foreclosure.
- [For sellers](https://drozq.com/sellers/): the live net-proceeds calculator plus how pricing, prep, and negotiation actually run.
- [Instant home valuation](https://drozq.com/value/): true market value, rebuild cost, renovated ceiling, and comparable sales for any address, delivered instantly.
- [The five-step process](https://drozq.com/process/): first call to closing day, with a written CMA in 24 hours and launch in 48 to 72.

## Live market data

- [Today's mortgage rates](https://drozq.com/rates/): 30y/15y benchmarks plus rates by loan program (conforming, jumbo, FHA, VA, USDA), refreshed every business day, with payment math.
- [California home prices](https://drozq.com/prices/): LA and San Diego Case-Shiller, the statewide FHFA index, months of supply, sales pace, and affordability, charted with a year of history.
- [SoCal market insights](https://drozq.com/market-insights/): county-by-county snapshot, refreshed monthly.

## Buy-side resources

- [For buyers](https://drozq.com/buyers/): the closing-cost estimator fed by today's live 30-year rate, payment-first budgeting, and how a search runs.
